name: Browser
description: A web browser in the desktop app's tabs, next to your notes: containers for several accounts side by side, Shields against ads and trackers, Chrome extensions, history and bookmarks, and agents working beside you. Links in notes and terminals open there, or in another browser with ⌘.
forAgents: Browse with `web-viewer.open` (`vau docs browsing` first), no Chrome extension tools.

pageBar.label: Page bar
pageBar.description: Back, the address and the page's buttons; hidden, the page fills its tab and the bar slides over it while the pointer rests at the page's top edge or its pane's (the gap above a card too), the address is focused (⌘L) or the tab is new. Right-click the bar to change it

openLinks.label: Open web links
openLinks.description: from notes and terminals, in the desktop app; a tab of the viewer (⌘-click: the browser), or always the browser

search.label: Search engine
search.description: for words typed in the address; one of these, or Custom, another's address with %s for the words

notifications.label: Notifications from pages
notifications.description: through the Inbox; a page's notifications (a new message) and Cloud sessions' news (one finished or waiting for you), as a toast, the Mac's notification while the app isn't in front, and a click opens its tab. False drops them

shields.label: Shields
shields.description: blocks ads, trackers and malware sites; with uBlock Origin's default lists (updated daily), YouTube's video ads too, and a page's Shields button shows how many requests were blocked on it

shieldsDown.label: Sites with Shields down
shieldsDown.description: nothing blocked there, like example.com; a site's subdomains too, and a page's Shields menu adds and removes its site

soundCard.label: Card for hidden tabs playing
soundCard.description: names a page playing in a tab you can't see; while a page plays sound in the background, a folded group or a hidden pane, a card in a corner names it, to pause, mute or show it. Closed, it stays away for that page till it plays again

playerFullScreen.label: Players open full screen
playerFullScreen.description: in a Space of their own; a page opened as a player (to watch it, or share its window in a call) fills a Space in full screen, and off: a window you can take full screen

hide.label: Parts of sites hidden
hide.description: ready-made rules, by name; turned on in a page's Shields menu: youtube-shorts (Shorts), youtube-recommendations (the home feed, Up next and end screens), youtube-comments. Your own are the blocked elements list (.vaultite/plugins/web-viewer/blocked-elements.md)

unstyled.label: Sites without their style
unstyled.description: their own CSS turned off for now; .vaultite/plugins/web-viewer/sites/<site>.css, in the vault's look, and a page's Shields menu turns it on and off

darkPages.label: Dark pages
darkPages.description: web pages follow the app's dark look; from their first frame: a site with a dark look of its own shows it, the rest are made dark, and a site with its own style keeps its style. Light, pages are as their sites make them

darkPagesLook.label: Dark pages look
darkPagesLook.description: how a light site is made dark; in the colour scheme's background, text and accents (canvas-drawn pages like Google Docs too, pictures toned to match), or Chromium's plain dark, pictures as they are

darkPagesOff.label: Sites without dark pages
darkPagesOff.description: left as they make themselves, like example.com; a site's subdomains too, and a page's Shields menu adds and removes its site
